name: Swiss American Sausage Co. - Lathrop CA

fieldNotes.location: Roster address 16500 Harlan Rd geocoded to a Shell gas station - wrong. Web search found the actual address: 251 D'Arcy Parkway, Lathrop (Crossroads Commerce Center). Located the matching meat/sausage plant at 37.8018,-121.2965 - single processing building with refrigerated docks, trailer yard, and a guard-booth entrance off D'Arcy Parkway. Locked center 37.8018,-121.2965.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. A red-paved entrance apron off D'Arcy Parkway leads to a controlled entry; the truck yard is fenced. Visible in Street View (2023-08) and satellite z20.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE. A small guard booth with a red-tile roof sits in the middle of the entry driveway, splitting it into separate lanes - a classic staffed guard shack. Clearly visible in Street View and confirmed on satellite z20.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a guard shack is present, so not remote check-in.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The driveway splits into separate in/out lanes around the central guard booth -> entry/exit separate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~12-14 refrigerated dock doors with reefer trailers (red tractors) backed in along the south building face, plus a few additional positions; ~16 total estimated, 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Row of ~12-15 parked trailers along the SE edge of the paved truck yard - dropArea 10-25, dedicated drop yard present.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long red-paved entry apron plus a large internal paved yard - easily holds 3+ trucks between gate and docks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved yard inside the gate before the docks serves as a staging/holding area.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lathrop is in the San Joaquin Valley / greater Stockton metro; the site is in a dense planned commerce-center industrial park - Urban.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on one south-face bank - combined ship/receive.
